title: WDD Init Command
description: Implement the `wdd init` command in `lib/wdd/cli.py`. This wire up the Compiler, takes the raw prompt string, generates the directories, and spits out the envelopes into the inbox.

requirements.compile: Must invoke the `BlueprintEngine` to run the 3-pass fan-out.

acceptance_criteria: `wdd init 'I want to build a trinket shop'` successfully generates a new WDD project tree.
